Track sobriety with alcohol-free streaks, craving management, and recovery milestones

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – a comprehensive sobriety tracking and support skill.

- Tracks alcohol-free streaks in days, weeks, and months
- Logs cravings, suggests coping strategies, and analyzes triggers
- Celebrates key recovery milestones (24h, 1w, 30d, 90d, 1y)
- Provides progress dashboards and money saved calculations
- Connects users to local recovery meetings and support resources
- Maintains user privacy; all data is stored locally
